title: Cinnamon girl - DUNKELBUNT ft.BOBAN I MARKO MARKOVIC ORKESTAR

lines.l: I met her on the murky way, who she was I cannot say
I only knew I wanted to stay, together we spent night and day
We used to fly through summer trees, the air was full of gossip reeds
Creeping how there's taste and smell, how many stories does it tell?
Hey, my little honeybee, honeybee, you're far away that's hurting me
Hurting me, that's your darling far away, your old sweet smile this summer day
I am in the middle of the river, on the other side of the earth
I am in the cold, without your chaleur, I need for my honor
En pleurant, je compte les jours comme tu me manques, mon amour
Vientain, on fera des voyages, l'enlucé sur les nuits
Hey, my little honeybee
Honeybee, you're far away, that's hurting me
Hurting me, I'm so darling, far away
You won't be small this summer day
We'll be right back.
It's time to leave to say goodbye
Please, oh darling, don't describe
Now when the sun comes rain and cry
Remember our days in the sky
My heart is beating every day
Since we had saved Faramels
Still can taste a tin of skin
It's not so good like cinnamon
Transcription by CastingWords
